operations.summary: Per-bin pileup weights data_pdf/mc_pdf from two profiles over the same binning (usually of the Poisson mean mu per bunch crossing), with n_eff, max_weight, raw input totals, and the bins where a weight is undefined or not representable

inputs.name: status
inputs.constraint: one of the core artifact_statuses; echoed as status (default: the bundle's status, else unvalidated)

failure_states.meaning: the bundle (positional JSON with data_profile, mc_profile, optional bin_centers and bin_edges) is unreadable or invalid, or a weight is undefined (MC empty where data is not) or not representable; stdout carries ok false and the reason
an argument is missing, malformed or out of range; stdout carries {"status": "failed", "ok": false, "error_kind": "invalid-input", "error": ...} and stderr the usage and one error line
